content: Design-from-scratch pitfalls: teams pick colors/spacing ad hoc per screen instead of defining a small token set (color, typography, spacing, radius) up front, producing multiple inconsistent visual languages as more screens are built. Professional SaaS dashboards (e.g. Linear) restrict to a small palette: ~3 type sizes, 2 weights, 1 accent color, 2-3 radius tokens, consistent spacing base-grid (4/8px) applied everywhere - reusing the same small token set is what reads as polished. Fix: define tokens and a small set of core components (15-20) before building feature screens; every new screen reuses existing tokens/components rather than introducing new one-off values.
